summary: Complaints centre on broken and waterlogged roads, drains and the sugar mill dues in Bijnor city and its district, while residents mainly appreciate better road connectivity and health services.
identity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_constituencies_of_the_Uttar_Pradesh_Legislative_Assembly (row: 22 Bijnor, None, Bijnor district); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bijnor_Assembly_constituency (extent: KC Mandawar, Bijnor, Dara Nagar, Mandawar NP, Jhalu NP and Bijnor MB of Bijnor Tehsil)

positives.english: Roads have made travel much easier now
positives.hindi: सड़कों से अब आना-जाना काफी आसान हो गया है
positives.basis: Local resident Neeraj, quoted in Amar Ujala's Bijnor Vidhan Sabha issues feature, says road connectivity has improved well; bridges, highway and road building eased travel (Bijnor city feature, not a road-by-road report)

positives.english: Nine of the ten mills paid the cane money on time
positives.hindi: दस में से नौ मिलों ने समय पर गन्ने का पैसा दिया
positives.basis: District-level, not AC-specific: Amar Ujala says nine of the district's ten sugar mills have paid cane prices on time; only Bilai mill is still owing, making partial payments

positives.english: The city's intersections have become beautiful now
positives.hindi: शहर के चौराहे अब सुंदर हो गए हैं
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (9 Sep 2026) reports Shastri, Jaji and Kisan chowks in Bijnor city redone and beautified (headline 'चमक गए चौराहे'); the same report says the roads leading to them are still damaged

positives.english: 137 health sub-centres in the district have got the NQAS quality certificate
positives.hindi: 137 स्वास्थ्य उपकेंद्रों को गुणवत्ता प्रमाण पत्र मिला
positives.basis: District-level, not AC-specific: Amar Ujala (16 Jul 2026) says 137 health sub-centres in Bijnor district received the NQAS certificate; district ranked 4th in state and 1st in division; CMO Dr Kaushalendra Singh named

positives.english: The MLA raised our issues at the top level, and some work has happened
positives.hindi: विधायक ने हमारे मुद्दे ऊपर तक उठाए, कुछ काम भी हुए
positives.basis: In the Amar Ujala feature, an unnamed resident says the MLA raised local issues at state level and development work followed; other residents said some work is still pending (single feature, vague claim)

negatives.english: Sugarcane dues of Rs 41.98 crore are still pending at Bilai sugar mill
negatives.hindi: बिलाई चीनी मिल पर 41.98 करोड़ गन्ना भुगतान बकाया है
negatives.basis: District-level, not AC-specific: Amar Ujala says Bilai mill owes Rs 41.98 crore and is making partial payments; farmers plan a sit-in from 15 Oct and have collected affidavits. The source places the mill only in Bijnor district; whether it lies in AC 22 is unconfirmed

negatives.english: There are potholes on Nagina and Chakkar roads, and the Jaji Chowk divider is broken
negatives.hindi: नगीना, चक्कर रोड पर गड्ढे हैं, जजी चौक का डिवाइडर टूटा है
negatives.basis: Bijnor city (Bijnor MB, inside AC extent): Amar Ujala reports Nagina Road badly potholed, Chakkar Road potholes filled with bricks, and Shastri to Jaji Chowk divider broken with vehicles climbing it at night; EE Hemant Pratap Singh said Nagina and Chakkar roads will be repaired after rains

negatives.english: Awas Vikas and Nai Basti get waterlogged in rain
negatives.hindi: बारिश में आवास विकास और नई बस्ती में पानी भर जाता है
negatives.basis: Bijnor city (inside AC extent): Amar Ujala reports Awas Vikas and Nai Basti waterlogged in rain; EO Megha Gupta said water is being pumped out. The article's '30 years' waterlogging remark refers to Kiratpur and is not used here

negatives.english: The Daranagar Ganj road widening has stopped for want of bitumen
negatives.hindi: दारानगर गंज वाली सड़क का चौड़ीकरण तारकोल न मिलने से रुका है
negatives.basis: Bijnor to Daranagar Ganj stretch (about 10 km, 7 m to 10 m widening, about Rs 18 crore); Dara Nagar is named in the AC extent on Wikipedia. Amar Ujala says Executive Engineer Hemant Pratap Singh said work stopped for lack of bitumen, pits dug on both sides are troubling drivers

negatives.english: A new drain built in Mandawar collapsed, and people allege substandard material was used
negatives.hindi: मंडावर में बनी नई नाली ढह गई, घटिया सामान का आरोप है
negatives.basis: Mandawar NP (KC Mandawar and Mandawar NP are in AC extent per Wikipedia): about 14 drains costing roughly Rs 1 crore under urban drainage scheme; one drain near Bijli Ghar fully collapsed; residents allege substandard material; SDM Smriti Mishra said an inquiry will be conducted (allegation, not proven)

notes: Round 2: AC 22 Bijnor (unreserved, Bijnor district) confirmed from Wikipedia list row and AC extent (KC Mandawar, Bijnor, Dara Nagar, Mandawar NP, Jhalu NP, Bijnor MB, Bijnor tehsil). Mandawar is inside AC 22 (confirmed by extent; Barhapur not relevant). Bilai sugar mill: the 10 Oct source says only 'Bijnor district'; a separate Amar Ujala search hit places the sugar-centre dispute at Batpura village in Haldaur police area, but that article was not fetched or used, and AC membership of Bilai mill remains unconfirmed. Excluded: Kadrabad-Hidayatpur-Pattharwala road (AC membership unconfirmed); Gangan bridge at Jasmora (Nahtaur area, outside AC 22 extent); Kiratpur and Sherkot waterlogging (other ACs). Positives: the Aug 31 feature still supports two items (road connectivity, MLA development); the rest are independent. Positive 2 and 4 are district-level. Field check: Bijnor-Daranagar Ganj road after rains, Mandawar drain inquiry outcome, Nagina and Chakkar repairs after rains, Bilai mill location and 15 Oct dharna outcome. Round 3 voice pass: spoken-voice rewording of P1, P2, P3, P5, N2, N4, N5; no facts added. P4 weak positive: the NQAS certificate is an official rating, not a service voters can see; district-level.

round2.changes: Opened and checked all 7 original Amar Ujala URLs; all support their items. Corrected: Sep 6 waterlogging item no longer uses the '30 years' remark (it refers to Kiratpur); Oct 4 is cited for affidavits only (no dues figure in it); Mandawar drain line now says one drain collapsed. Replaced the Faheem health item (same Aug 31 feature) with an independent Jul 16 2026 district NQAS report; mill payment item marked district-level; Mandawar and Dara Nagar confirmed inside AC extent on Wikipedia; Hindi lines shortened to 13 words or fewer; positives re-ranked (only 2 of 5 now from the Aug 31 feature).
